value.title: Sword Dancer
value.synopsis: Honoka is traveling in the desert when she stumbles upon a young man about to be ambushed by desert creatures. She and her companion AI, Bogie, rescue the young man and learn that his name is Iks.

value.title: A Busy Night
value.synopsis: Honoka goes to Zankan, a friend and mechanic, to have her sand tank inspected. We also meet Jouganki, a Third with a strange connection to Honoka.

value.title: Town of the Desert
value.synopsis: Honoka does some mundane jobs in the desert town of Emporium to earn some money.

value.title: Blue Breaker
value.synopsis: Honoka receives a PSP Suit from Zankan, but as Honoka leaves, a Blue Breaker kills Zankan.

value.title: The Blue Astral Eye
value.synopsis: Honoka and Millie struggle to comprehend Zankan's Death.

value.title: The Wind That Sweeps the Land
value.synopsis: Honoka fights the Blue Breaker that killed Zankan.

value.title: Straight until Dawn
value.synopsis: Honoka attempts to protect a queen ant from enemies until it is strong enough to fly away.

value.title: Emporium's Afternoon
value.synopsis: Herds of sand dragons in the desert are stampeding for an unknown reason. A teacher at a school in Emporium possesses a strange power. The Third are investigating a crisis regarding a dimensional distortion.

value.title: Paifu
value.synopsis: Having been employed to search for the reason behind the fright of the sand dragons, Honoka goes off to the desert. Paifu joins Honoka as a partner. In the night, they have to deal with assassins after Paifu.

value.title: Desert's Tombstone
value.synopsis: The expedition group reaches the dimensional distortion, which is called Gravestone.

value.title: Fight with the Illusion
value.synopsis: The dimensional distortion engulfs the group and traps them in an interdimensional threshold. Honoka and Iks both disappeared.

value.title: The Respective Reason
value.synopsis: Gravestone tries to kill each separated individual.

value.title: Desert's Folklore
value.synopsis: Honoka takes a break from work by traveling in the desert with Millie and Iks.

value.title: Fairy Hallucination
value.synopsis: Millie was rescued by a fairy and wolf when attacked by a monster in the desert.

value.title: Night of the Sandstorm
value.synopsis: The group search for the fairy and the wolf. Honoka opposes Leon's search for the fairy and is almost killed.

value.title: The Life which Dances Boisterously
value.synopsis: Honoka is healed by Kamui the wolf. When they resume their search for the fairy, they encounter Leon again.

value.title: Rôna Fauna
value.synopsis: Rona Fauna, one of Third, has seized control of the wormhole drive weapon and is holding Jouganki prisoner. Honoko has been asked to rescue him.

value.title: Motion
value.synopsis: Two unexpected individuals join Honoka’s rescue team.

value.title: Force Breaking
value.synopsis: Honoka gets separated from Bogie and Paifu and has to join forces with Blue Breaker.

value.title: Over the Dead Line
value.synopsis: Paifu and Bogie defeat their opponents. Rona Fauna becomes very weak from overusing her powers and becomes unable to control her powers.

value.title: Feelings That Won't Reach You
value.synopsis: Rona expresses her love for Jouganki and her jealousy for Honoka.

value.title: Mirage of A Past Soul
value.synopsis: Rona has a showdown with Honoka and the wormhole driver is activated to destroy the entire planet.

value.title: To The Steel Valley
value.synopsis: Both Iks and Honoka for different reasons to head to the Steel Gorge and face the Third.

value.title: The Story Starts from Now
value.synopsis: Jouganki, Iks and Honoka go into the crevasse of the Steel Gorge to meet the Observer of the planet.
